_README: Brent term structure snapshot, taken Monday when markets reopen. Backwardation (M1 > deferred) = physical tightness. Backwardation EASING (spread shrinking toward 0 / flipping to contango) = tightness relaxing before any headline says so. Update 'curve' each Monday with front-month settlement out to M6, and append the M1-M3 spread to 'spread_history'. No free tidy API for the futures curve — pull from ICE Brent settlements, Barchart, or Investing.com.
